display_long_description:
**No dull duel survives! ANIMAL BATTLEGROUNDS WAITS.**

This is your FREE multiplayer alien sandbox battle arena where you **explore, shoot and fight**. Inspired by classic shooters and the fast-paced combat system, you can challenge friends (or enemies!)  No scripts—just raw, player-driven action combat. Explore massive alien ruins. Whether you're fighting or fooling around, every move reshapes the battlefield. 

👉 Join our **Discord** & **get rewards**: https://discord.gg/abvr
[media]
⚔️  **Intense PvP Combat - Non-Stop Action**

Fight friends in **Diverse terrian**. Fling enemies, strike from shadows, or blast them up close. **Swing, grapple, teleport, dash, and jump across** the arena, jump into the sky with giant jump pads![media]
⚔️  **Try Out Rich Weaponry**

Master everything from **ranger bow** and guns **magical wands** to make your battles exhilarating; swing blades, **throw axes**, equip **boxing gloves**, lay down **slowing mines, or toss poison smoke grenades**—turn the battlefield into a chaotic playground.[media]

💰  **Upgrade & Unlock Talent Tree**

Progress through a deep Talent Tree to unlock powerful abilities and customize your combat style. Shape your fighter’s skills and strengths to match how you play—whether you prefer speed, raw power, or tactical control. Build your legend, one skill at a time.[media]


🌀 **Multiple Game Modes & Rich Content**
- PvP Combat, Boss Fights, 1v1 Boxing Duel & Team Matches
- Character Customization
- Weapon System: Wield crazy weapons, gadgets, bombs, bows, staves, boxing gloves, etc.
- Skill Progression: Unlock Talent Tree
